primary.title: Next ITR filing in July 2027: Here's the month-wise checklist salaried taxpayers should follow starting today
primary.summary: Salaried taxpayers should start preparing now for ITR filing for Tax Year 2026-27. Maintaining tax documents, tracking investments, checking AIS and Form 26AS, reviewing deductions and comparing tax regimes can help avoid last-minute errors.
